changes.sprites: Store eight lossless poses; use transpose/mirror addressing to reconstruct all sixteen poses with original metallic shades and one-clock latency.
changes.memory: A retains all three complete external SDRAM frame slots. B uses two current/next raw SDRAM slots with the transmit lock and actual-HDMI settings pin preserved. Reducing external slots does not by itself release on-chip block RAM.
changes.preserved: A HDMI/touch wiring, B preprocessing and AV2 envelope offload, 11 transitions, sparse dwell ripples, trophy spotlights and light tail, BMP24 decoding, audio and thumbnail preview.
changes.throughput: B overlaps next-word source FIFO reads with the current low pixel. Existing TF driver is unchanged: S_WAIT_READ_WRITE already sets divider zero in 5.2, so 25MHz data SPI is not a new speed improvement. Clock constraints, precision and link clock are unchanged.
changes.blend: Three spare native EG_PHY_MULT18 DSPs replace LUT Booth multipliers, preserving exact signed products and registered latency; A display FIFO and B PCM capacity are unchanged.

on_chip_ram_note: Whole images reside in external SDRAM. Reported on-chip RAM changes come from actual animation synthesis, not from deleting an external frame slot.

page_link.conditions: Always-ready raw source and no externally forced receiver stalls; real FIFO, image processing, native+effect planes, source prefetch, receiver state machine and CRC32. Same 25MHz link configuration.

fast_processing.conditions: Raw native RGB565 queue, independent FIFO schedules, exact sequence compared with frozen 5.2; no output link bottleneck in this isolated processor measurement.
